title: Camp Potlatch (Reserve)

services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: Located on 133 acres of pristine wilderness along the picturesque shores of the beautiful Howe Sound, thousands of campers have passed through the gates of Camp Potlatch over the past 80 years. Sandy beaches and unspoiled hiking territory create an idyllic environment for campers to explore and play. Experience the adventure of a lifetime at our one-of-a kind wilderness camp site. Reach new heights on a natural rock wall, hit a bullseye at the archery range, paddle the sea in a canoe and create an artistic masterpiece in the arts and crafts room.
